page.overview:
Who is Jade Rabbit Spirit?

The is a demon who impersonated the Princess of India. She turned out to be the that lives on the Moon.

The Jade Rabbit Spirit has shiny red eyes, sharp teeth, divided lips, a creamy straight nose, jade fur, and fleecy feet.

The Jade Rabbit Spirit was once the jade rabbit which pounded the elixir of life for the Star Lord of Supreme Yin. One night, the jade rabbit was slapped by the moon goddess Lady White, an insult she never forgave her for. When she discovered that Lady White had chosen to reincarnate herself as the princess of India, the jade rabbit chose to follow her.

One night, the Jade Rabbit Spirit conjured a strong wind which blew the princess all the way from Shravasti to Jetavana, then assumed her form.
